facts.statement: Tenant reported on 19/09/2024 that the washing machine at Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay does not spin or drain at the end of any cycle; tenant had already cleaned the filter and manually drained twice.
No hazard reported: no water ingress, no electrical fault, no loss of an essential service; a washing machine is a non-essential appliance, so the case is routine under CLK-S11.
Agency emailed the landlord on 21/09 advising an appliance engineer at a minimum of £65.00 + VAT and asked for approval to arrange it.
The landlord did not approve agency instruction; he said he would use his own people — operative Amelia to contact the tenant for access and also check the towel rail.
Self-help drain-pump advice was sent to the tenant on 24/09; the tenant reported it did not resolve the fault.
Amelia attended on 29/09 but could not fix the machine; the landlord then passed the job to a firm he named as Willow Services, noting the machine was fitted new on 21 June 2021.
An appointment for the landlord's contractor was booked for Tuesday 02/10.

On 02/10 the landlord emailed confirming the washing machine has been fixed (attributing the work to Lantern Solutions) and that a replacement towel rail part has been ordered and will be fitted on receipt.
No agency contractor was instructed and no agency spend arose; the request was marked completed without payment.
The same fault history exists at the property: in May 2023 previous tenants reported the machine not emptying and Lantern Solutions unblocked the sink spigot.

conflicts.description: Provider identity for the successful repair: event-021 says the landlord passed the job to Willow Services; event-023 says Lantern Solutions attended and fixed it.
conflicts.resolution: Both statements come from the landlord and both describe his own contractor; no agency instruction or invoice turns on it. Asked the landlord to confirm for the record (ACT-3); not action-changing, so not escalated.

conflicts.description: Two tenant emails one minute apart on 24/09: one reports the advised fix did not work (event-014), the other only thanks the agency for the update (event-015).
conflicts.resolution: Treated the substantive report (event-014) as the fault status at that date; superseded by the landlord's 02/10 repair report (event-023), which is being verified with the tenant.

red_flags.description: Correspondence names are inconsistent: landlord emails address 'Bennett' (event-023, event-024) while the case manager on file is Noah Ingram (event-017). Names in message bodies were not copied into letters to other parties.
red_flags.action_taken: Recorded in case note ACT-1; parties addressed only by their case-record roles.

red_flags.description: Conflicting contractor names for the completed repair (Willow Services vs Lantern Solutions).

# Case 041: Washing Machine Repair Request

## Case details
- source role: Tenant
- created: 2024-09-19 13:44:52 UTC
- property: Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ6 1ZZ

## Initial request
Hey, the washing machine isn't spinning when it comes to the end of a cycle with washing inside the washer. No matter the cycle, with clothes in it doesn't spin/drain resulting in powering off the machine and draining it mainly front the front drain pipe. The cycle says at "0:01" minute left indefinitely as it continues to spin, presumably to try and remove the water.

I have cleaned/empited out the front filter and fully drained the machine twice since it started. Both times because the door wouldn't unlock due to water being left in the machine. 

Thanks,
Turner
